blocks.x: If you, like me, need to get out the laptop and crack your knuckles before booking a trip, you understand the business of comparing hotel prices. Trivago is a reliable travel search engine that’s been occupying browser tabs since 2005; it’s hard to shake the company’s punchy “Hotel? Trivago” catchline, introduced to us by way of cheeky TV commercials. But how exactly does Trivago set itself apart from the pack? It’s a metasearch engine that compares accommodation prices across various booking sites—a springboard, if you will, for the actual reservation process. This is the website you come to to sift through the noise.

Founded in 2005 in Düsseldorf, Germany, by three college friends—Rolf Schrömgens, Peter Vinnemeier, and Malte Siewert—Trivago began as an effort to simplify the hotel search by highlighting price fragmentation all in one place—letting globetrotters see all the best deals from across the internet on one platform. If you’re a price-conscious traveler looking to incorporate Trivago into your planning process, these are the best ways to save on the site, with Trivago hotel deals, coupons, and promo codes.
Save up to 40% on fall stays with Trivago hotel deals

When mapping out a fall break, make sure you start with Trivago; you can compare discounts of up to 40% on hotel stays with the site's savings options, all aggregated for your convenience. You'll be able to access a vast selection of accommodations—with close to 1.7 million hotels available in the US—that are easily sortable via convenient filters, like properties in popular cities or those with free cancellation. Some standout Trivago hotel deals include a $234-per-night stay at Tryp by Wyndham in Aruba (53% less than top sites), as well as a $119 nightly rate at Castle Maui Banyan in Hawaii (29% less than similar stays). It won’t take long to identify top Trivago offers tailored to your dates and preferences, no matter the city.
Trivago deals for under $99 per night

In this economy, finding a top-tier hotel stay for less than $100 feels like hitting the jackpot. But thanks to Trivago’s “Under $99” filter on the Deal Finder page, you can absolutely score that summer bargain—including deals as low as $59! Find budget hotel stays both in the US and abroad, with noteworthy offers like the Villa del Palmar stay in Cancun, or this Orlando gem for $69.
Save on Trivago deals for last-minute trips

It’s never too late to start booking that last-minute vacation. Head to Trivago's deals page under the section for hotel deals for the next seven days, and you’ll find properties with savings of up to 40% for last-minute availability in September and beyond. Be flexible with your exact location to uncover even greater Trivago deals for spontaneous stays.
Sign up for the Trivago newsletter for updates & inspiration

Far too often, we get caught up in the slog of life and need a reminder to book that next trip before it’s too late. When you sign up for the Trivago newsletter, you’ll be notified of the latest deals on hotels, perhaps some in locations you might not have thought of yourself. You can also maximize your savings by setting up price alerts on Trivago for your desired destinations and travel dates to be notified when deals drop, or subscribe to Trivago’s partner booking sites to receive exclusive Trivago coupons and offers directly to your inbox.
